Neriak Vendors

Listed here are the Neriak Vendors. Once you enter the spell casters guild in Neriak Commons you will find the General vendor (Tkaz H'Rugla), a Magician vendor (Mys S'Tai), and an Enchanter vendor (Litz B'Doph). There is one Enchanter vendor on the top floor (Sym L'Crit) and the rest of the spell vendors can be found in the basement. The Wizard vendors are in the basement behind the first door on the left, the Enchanter vendors the second door on the left, and the door on the right contains the Magician vendors. The room at the end of the hall is the Neriak Library containing spells from all three classes (Enchanter, Magician, and Wizard). The Necromancer vendors are found in Neriaks 3rd Quater. That vendor list will be forthcoming.
